# DUP Labs

Evidence-first **hybrid Python + Rust L1** — product **DUP Protocol**. Local prod-profile mesh, fail-closed gates, honest status. **Not** a launched public mainnet. **Not** a listed token.

**Brand:** [BRAND](https://github.com/Gruver87/dup-protocol-experimental/blob/main/docs/BRAND.md) · **Diligence (15 min):** [DILIGENCE_BRIEF](https://github.com/Gruver87/dup-protocol-experimental/blob/main/docs/DILIGENCE_BRIEF.md)  
**Author:** Uladzimir Dabranski (D.U.P.) — Dabranski · Uladzimir · Petrovich

## Positioning (honest)

- **Claims require artifacts** — soak reports, lab scripts, industrial gates, evidence packs.
- **Two trees on purpose** — industrial pin stays freeze-safe; Experimental absorbs transport / Long-Range risk.
- **Gaps stay visible** — [MAINNET_GAP_ANALYSIS](https://github.com/Gruver87/dup-protocol/blob/master/docs/MAINNET_GAP_ANALYSIS.md) · Experimental blockers in [EXECUTION_ORDER](https://github.com/Gruver87/dup-protocol-experimental/blob/main/docs/EXECUTION_ORDER.md).
